channel.title: Business Today India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Today India (businesstoday.in)

item.title: 'Decided to give 0% tariff on some cancer medications, neuro treatment': Piyush Goyal on what US got
item.description: India-US interim trade agreement: Goyal mentioned that New Delhi has also considered exemptions for some medical equipment whose imports are necessary at present, despite them being developed in India.

item.title: India-US interim trade agreement: 'No GM modified product allowed, agri sector protected,' says Piyush Goyal
item.description: He also said that the interests of India's farmers and dairy sector have been protected in the agreement.

item.title: India-US BTA: Harley Davidson bikes to get 0% duty, gradual tariff reduction on luxury cars
item.description: India expects nearly $74 billion worth of exports to benefit from lower tariff by the US, External Affairs ministry to clarify on purchase of Russian crude oil

item.title: After mass layoffs, Washington Post publisher Will Lewis resigns; Jeff D’Onofrio named acting CEO
item.description: Lewis informed employees of his departure in a brief two-paragraph email, saying that after two years of transformation, "now is the right time for me to step aside."

item.title: Moltbook hype unravels: Viral posts were human-written, not AI, finds MIT Technology Review
item.description: Moltbook is a vibe-coded Reddit-style platform that billed itself as a social network for AI agents.

item.title: 'The real sting is the monitoring': Brahma Chellaney flags risk for India in Trump's Russian oil order
item.description: Chellaney said the order formally assigns the US commerce secretary the task of tracking India's oil sourcing, creating a clear trigger for action

item.title: NSE IPO may unlock mega gains for billionaire investors RK Damani, Premji
item.description: NSE’s latest quarterly shareholding data showed PI Opportunities Fund I, an Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) backed by Premji Invest, among NSE’s top shareholders.

item.title: 'India has played it pretty safe, deal is very balanced': Top agri economist on India–US trade agreement
item.description: India has agreed to eliminate or reduce tariffs on a wide range of US food and agricultural products, including dried distillers' grains, red sorghum for animal feed, tree nuts, fresh and processed fruit, soybean oil, wine and spirits, and additional products

item.title: Cyber attacks, AI misuse and data privacy rules emerge as top boardroom risks for India Inc
item.description: Around 60% of senior executives said inadequate adoption of emerging technologies, including AI, was negatively impacting operational effectiveness.
